overview: Anthropic’s IPO raises unprecedented capital, highlighting deep investor commitment to AI startups.
Apple is reportedly building a multi‑tool AI agent for macOS, signaling entry into the computer‑task automation race.
AWS adds automated monitoring for generative AI inference, aiming to curb performance drift and cost waste.

top.title: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
top.summary: Anthropic went public, raising $81.3 billion; founders sold shares worth $1.95 billion, each netting about $280 million. Major tech firms bought $26 billion of non‑voting Class N stock, giving them roughly 28% ownership.

top.title: Get started with Daybreak Blue
top.summary: OpenAI released a walkthrough video for Daybreak Blue, demonstrating the onboarding process and initial setup steps for new users.

top.title: Explore the Codex Security Plugin
top.summary: OpenAI showcased a demo of the Codex Security Plugin, illustrating how the tool scans code and reports security findings.

top.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
top.summary: Apple filed a job posting for a senior manager to lead development of an AI agent that can operate macOS apps, browse the web, and write code, indicating a push into autonomous computer agents.

top.title: Court: 4th Amendment Disallows Use Of AI-Generated 'Probable Cause'
top.summary: A court ruled that AI‑generated probable‑cause statements cannot satisfy the Fourth Amendment, emphasizing legal limits on AI‑derived evidence in criminal proceedings.

top.title: Amazon SageMaker AI now detects latency drift, idle GPUs, and missed optimizations on your inference endpoints
top.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI now automatically monitors inference endpoints for latency drift, idle GPUs, and missed optimizations, providing actionable recommendations via AWS Health notifications.
